description: The >>EVALUATE / >>WHEN / >>WHEN OTHER / >>END-EVALUATE conditional-compilation directive (ISO §2023:7.3.13, both formats: a selection subject and the TRUE form) - one of the three §2023:7.3.5 conditional-compilation directives. The three words are ONE construct (a >>WHEN outside a >>EVALUATE is not a directive), so they share a row. Implemented by ConditionalCompilationProcessor; the introduction gate rejects the directive words below 2002. The §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction: COBOL-85 has no compiler directives at all, so a '>>' line cannot occur in a conforming COBOL-85 source. The edition edge below 2023 is DERIVED, not quoted (VCR Table 7's discipline, rows 7.19/7.20 - the repo holds no 2002 or 2014 text, ratified decision #1): the derivation is (a) the M2 post-85 feature catalog in docs/ISO2023_CONFORMANCE_PLAN.md, which places '*>' inline comments, >>SOURCE FORMAT, conditional compilation and 'recognize-and-ignore of the other standard >> directives' in COBOL-2002, (b) the sibling row leap-second-directive-2002, already landed on the same derivation (kb/Work PB65), and (c) Annex E, which itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and does NOT list this directive among the additions, so it predates 2023. Overturnable in one line if the 2002/2014 text is ever acquired.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.13; the §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR Table 7 discipline)

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.13.2 general format: a selection subject or TRUE, with >>WHEN objects — evaluated and diagnosed by the conditional-compilation driver as COBOL1619; >>END-EVALUATE writes no operand (checked centrally, §2023:7.3.3 SR3/SR4, as COBOL1911) and the driver's frame stack diagnoses the directive's structure as COBOL2649.

source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725EV.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
       >>EVALUATE TRUE
       >>WHEN 1 = 1
           DISPLAY "X".
       >>END-EVALUATE
           STOP RUN.
